name: wormhook
description: Local supply-chain malware detection for Claude Code. Matches Shai-Hulud (including OpenAPI token-monitor persistence), CanisterWorm, PolinRider JavaScript (including loaders hidden in files presented as fonts and run from editor tasks), ChainDrop, Miasma/Hades, Axios, SANDWORM_MODE, node-ipc, and TrapDoor indicators. Blocks guarded commands and human turns on findings in agent configuration, Python startup files, git hooks, project source, and dependencies. Warns on ambiguous credential-access and obfuscation patterns.
